Annotation Interface AutoConfigureRestDocs

@Target(TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented @Inherited @ImportAutoConfiguration @Import(org.springframework.boot.restdocs.test.autoconfigure.RestDocumentationContextProviderRegistrar.class) @PropertyMapping("spring.test.restdocs") public @interface AutoConfigureRestDocs
Annotation that can be applied to a test class to enable and configure auto-configuration of Spring REST Docs. The auto-configuration sets up MockMvc-based testing of a servlet web application or WebTestClient-based testing of a reactive web application.

允许配置输出目录以及生成 URIs 的主机、方案和端口。如果需要进一步配置，可以使用 RestDocsMockMvcConfigurationCustomizer 或 RestDocsWebTestClientConfigurationCustomizer Bean。

4.0.0
Author:
Andy Wilkinson
